<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | CONFIRMED |
| Confidence | HIGH |
| Severity | HIGH |
| Task Type | Bug fix — verification policy preflight and init preservation |

### What Was Claimed

A schema-valid required `npm test` policy can target a repository root without a test script in a monorepo, so orchestration reaches implementation before discovering that the immutable approved command cannot run. ForgeDock must support safe package working directories, statically reject impossible required checks before writers, and keep genuinely configured required checks fail-closed.

### What We Found

- The frozen base already contains a repository-relative `cwd` field, path canonicalization, and static preflight coverage for missing directories, executables, and npm-family scripts.
- Work-on calls preflight after creating the isolated base worktree but before `materializeForgeAgents`, journal launch, or any writer spawn, which is the correct trust boundary for checking the frozen base.
- `/forge:init` parses an existing policy but unconditionally writes `verification.commands: {}`. Re-running setup therefore silently removes all tracked local checks, including valid monorepo commands and required checks that should remain fail-closed.
- New template setup starts with an empty command map, but the UI does not state that this is an intentional CI-only choice or offer a safe way to retain/validate existing local commands.
- The existing script recognizer handles direct `npm|pnpm|yarn|bun` test/run forms but diagnostics can be made more actionable by naming `/forge:init` and the exact policy path.

### Root Cause

Policy initialization treats verification commands as transient setup output instead of a tracked safety contract. Although the runtime preflight now validates the selected `cwd`, initialization discards the contract before the next run. This can disable required local verification without operator intent and makes setup behavior ambiguous for monorepos.

### Affected Files

| Path | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `src/ui/commands.ts` | Preserve validated tracked commands and make CI-only setup explicit. |
| `src/adapters/verification-preflight.ts` | Keep static package checks and improve remediation diagnostics. |
| `src/core/policy.ts` | Existing `cwd` normalization is the policy contract to preserve. |
| `src/workflows/work-on.ts` | Existing preflight placement is the writer gate to regression-test. |
| `test/adapters/verification-preflight.test.ts` | Extend monorepo and remediation coverage. |
| `test/ui/commands.test.ts` | Cover init verification-policy selection/preservation through pure setup behavior. |

### Evidence

- `.forge/config.json` currently has a required `check` command bound to `cwd: "."`; the code path reads it, then `/forge:init` replaces the command map with `{}`.
- `preflightRequiredVerificationCommands` resolves and realpaths `cwd`, rejects escapes/control directories, checks executable availability, and reads only `package.json` scripts.
- The monorepo fixture has no root `test` script and a `web/package.json` `test` script; root selection fails and `web` selection passes.
- `startIssue` invokes preflight before `materializeForgeAgents` and before either direct or orchestrated writer launch.
- `child-runtime.ts` independently resolves the bound `cwd` before executing an approved check and preserves nonzero exit status, retaining fail-closed post-implementation behavior.

### History Findings

No additional mutable history was accepted as authority beyond the frozen base. The frozen source and tests show that cwd/preflight work was already introduced, while init command preservation and explicit CI-only signaling remain incomplete.

### Recommendation

Keep the existing static preflight and safe cwd contract. Change setup to retain an existing tracked command map (after static validation), leave a new template explicitly CI-only, surface the mode in setup output, and strengthen diagnostics/tests without executing repository commands during preflight.

### Related Issues

- Issue #94 — required verification policy is not preflighted for monorepos.

### Decomposition Assessment

Single bounded change across policy setup, static preflight diagnostics, and regression tests. No decomposition or product decision is required.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] Approved commands have a validated repository-relative working directory.
- [ ] `/forge:init` never invents `npm test` for a package without a matching script; new setup remains explicitly CI-only and existing commands are retained rather than silently removed.
- [ ] Required commands are statically preflighted against the frozen worktree before any writer launches.
- [ ] Missing executable, package directory, or npm script errors include the exact policy path and a concrete `/forge:init`/config remediation.
- [ ] Monorepo regression coverage distinguishes root-without-script from a valid package cwd.
- [ ] Required checks that fail after implementation remain blocking.
